skins.flavorText: \"Blade in hand, she decided it was time to take a stand\"

skins.name: Marina
skins.description: Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. It has been painted with a hydrographic in a contrasting yellow and blue pattern.
skins.flavorText: Some people will call you a hero... others a villain

skins.name: Leather
skins.description: Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. Its stock has been wrapped in brown leather.
skins.flavorText: Don't worry, the safety is TSA compliant

skins.name: Neon Ply
skins.description: Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. It has been laminated and filled with every neon color imaginable.
skins.flavorText: \"Roy G. Biv? Never heard of 'em.\"

skins.name: Astrolabe
skins.description: Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. A metallic design has been applied over a dark-colored base.
skins.flavorText: \"IT'S NOT A CIRCUIT BOARD!\"

skins.name: Tranquility
skins.description: The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. It has been hand painted with the image of a woman with long hair.
skins.flavorText: I'm not here for what I need; I'm here for something I want - Imogen and The Oni Part 2

skins.name: Dark Water
skins.description: A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It has been painted in an aquatic-stripe pattern with charcoal metallic paints of various reflectivities over a chrome base coat.
skins.flavorText: Water gives life, but it can also take it...

skins.name: Fever Dream
skins.description: High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been custom painted with pink, blue, and purple drawings atop a black base.
skins.flavorText: Delirium is a dangerous thing

skins.name: Nemesis
skins.description: Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. It has been custom painted with the image of a metallic monster.
skins.flavorText: It's coming for you

skins.name: Obsidian
skins.description: Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. It has been custom painted to look like it was submerged in lava and is solidifying into obsidian as it cools.
skins.flavorText: Giving the term \"glass cannon\" a whole new meaning

skins.name: High Roller
skins.description: The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. It has been custom painted with poker chips, dice, and a royal flush over a red base.
skins.flavorText: All in

skins.name: Disco Tech
skins.description: Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been custom painted using a pearlescent finish to resemble holographic self-adhesive vinyl. Depending on the light its appearance changes.
skins.flavorText: Watch when you point that thing

skins.name: Llama Cannon
skins.description: The R8 Revolver delivers a highly accurate and powerful round at the expense of a lengthy trigger-pull. Firing rapidly by fanning the hammer may be the best option when point-blank stopping power is required. Its ivory handle is paired with ornate, engraved flourishes on blue metalwork.
skins.flavorText: Pull the lever

skins.name: Red Tire
skins.description: The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been spray-painted with a black and red tire tread pattern.
skins.flavorText: Burn rubber

skins.name: Tempest
skins.description: The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. This memento from Seaside has been painted with a wave and cloud motif hydrographic.
skins.flavorText: A storm is coming

skins.name: Night Borre
skins.description: A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It has been spray-painted with a Norse inspired pattern of interlocking blue rings.
skins.flavorText: \"It is better to fight and fall than to live without hope\"

skins.name: Rust Leaf
skins.description: An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. It has been spray-painted with an orange pattern of overlapping leaves.
skins.flavorText: Blood on the leaves

skins.name: Bamboo Shadow
skins.description: The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. It has been painted with a hydrographic of brush-painted bamboo.
skins.flavorText: Kotaro lost his son to this gun... and one day he'll use it to stop the man responsible

skins.name: Colony
skins.description: Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. It has individual parts spray-painted khaki and grey.

skins.name: Conspiracy
skins.description: As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been painted with dark, metallic paint and pale yellow accents.

skins.name: Cut Out
skins.description: An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. An intricate pattern of butterflies and floral details has been applied.
skins.flavorText: Spring has sprung

skins.description: As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

skins.name: Fleet Flock
skins.description: Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. It has been given a hydrographic of birds flying through clouds.

skins.flavorText: Planning is one thing, executing is another

skins.name: CaliCamo
skins.description: The Negev is a beast that can keep the enemy at bay with its pin-point supressive fire, provided you have the luxury of time to gain control over it. It has been painted using a VariCamo patterned hydrographic.
skins.flavorText: Rebuilding only comes in the wake of destruction

skins.name: Yellow Jacket
skins.description: A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. It has been custom painted with curved shapes.
skins.flavorText: Float like a butterfly, sting like a relentless hateful insect

skins.name: Storm
skins.description: Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a stormy color scheme.
skins.flavorText: It will be waiting for you at the monorail

skins.name: Shinobu
skins.description: The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been custom painted with a woman on the slide wearing SR Tech \"Premium\" contact lenses.

skins.name: Nightshade

skins.name: Scorched
skins.description: Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. It has been spray-painted in a sun-dappled pattern.

skins.name: Phoenix Chalk

skins.name: Asterion

skins.name: Rust Coat

skins.name: Solitude

skins.flavorText: Being alone is a privilege, not a burden

skins.name: Navy Murano
skins.description: Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. A blue hydrographic of Murano beads has been applied.
skins.flavorText: Death by a thousand beads

skins.name: Blast From the Past
skins.description: An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. A pale green and beige pattern of ancient tiles has been applied.
skins.flavorText: \"Hope remains, even for those began their journey down the wrong path\"

skins.name: Nitro
skins.description: Often imitated but never equaled, the iconic MP5 is perhaps the most versatile and popular SMG in the world. This SD variant features an integrated silencer, making an already formidable weapon whisper-quiet. It has individual parts spray-painted black and tangerine orange.
skins.flavorText: Rona is as good as she thinks she is... she's just not old enough to realize she shouldn't point it out to everyone - Felix Riley, Commanding Officer

skins.name: Melondrama
skins.description: Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. These berettas have been custom painted with a twisted, frightening depiction of a watermelon over a navy blue background.
skins.flavorText: Sweet dreams...

skins.name: Fizzy POP
skins.description: With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. A tan and red retro techno-inspired pattern has been applied.
skins.flavorText: Wars are won with information

skins.name: Mount Fuji
skins.description: Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. An acrylic painting of Mount Fuji at dawn has been applied. The painting is used as a pattern, so each weapon may appear different.
skins.flavorText: The red sun rises

skins.name: Handgun
skins.description: Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. It has been custom painted with a hand making an aiming gesture.
skins.flavorText: No more fun and games

skins.name: Slalom
skins.description: A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. It has been custom painted with a multicolored abstract design.
skins.flavorText: Black diamond gun

skins.name: Attack Vector
skins.description: Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. It has been custom painted with a multicolored abstract design.
skins.flavorText: Aggressive angles of attack

skins.name: Retrobution
skins.description: Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. It was been custom painted with a retro hydrographic.
skins.flavorText: Some things never go out of style

skins.name: Slate
skins.description: Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. A custom paint job has been applied which can only be described as \"black on black on slate black\".
skins.flavorText: \"Call a doctor, they're gonna need one\"

skins.name: Kiss♥Love
skins.description: The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. It has been custom painted with a starry-eyed woman in pink and purple.
skins.flavorText: \"I won't take no for an answer; I have to have it!\"

skins.name: K.O. Factory
skins.description: The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. This custom paint job is inspired by old animation cartoons.
skins.flavorText: Swing and a miss!

skins.name: Wild Child
skins.description: The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. Beneath sketches of bullets, a crown, and other designs, bands of neon color are the base of this custom painted UMP-45.
skins.flavorText: The concept is simple, it's the execution that's difficult

skins.name: XOXO
skins.description: The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. A vividly colored, punk-inspired pattern has been applied.
skins.flavorText: Yeah, right…

skins.name: Midnight Laminate
skins.description: Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. The buttstock, handguard, and grip have been painted blue. The rest of the AK-47 has been painted iridescent purple.
skins.flavorText: That's one way to get their attention…

skins.name: Hexane
skins.description: A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It has been painted using a hexagon patterned hydrographic.

skins.name: Orange Murano
skins.description: An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. An orange hydrographic of Murano beads has been applied.
skins.flavorText: Death by a thousand beads

skins.name: Night
skins.description: The R8 Revolver delivers a highly accurate and powerful round at the expense of a lengthy trigger-pull. Firing rapidly by fanning the hammer may be the best option when point-blank stopping power is required. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a night ops color scheme.
skins.flavorText: It's the whisper of the wind... it's the bite at your neck

skins.name: Light Rail
skins.description: As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. Its custom paint job creates an optical illusion and appears to change the weapon's geometry.
skins.flavorText: Required power supply sold separately

skins.name: Parallax
skins.description: The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. The colors in this custom paint job were applied in offset positions, leading to an eye-popping look.
skins.flavorText: Shoot twice, kill once

skins.name: Acheron
skins.description: High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. A multicolored hydrographic pattern has been applied.

skins.name: Desert Blossom

skins.name: Forest Leaves
skins.description: The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. It has been spray-painted using leaves as stencils.

skins.name: Forest Night
skins.description: A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been painted using a forest camouflage hydrographic.
skins.flavorText: The woods can be a dangerous place... never travel alone

skins.name: Grinder
skins.description: The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. The steel slide has been painted using a combination of stenciling and hand-painting using oil paints.

skins.name: Whitefish

skins.name: Green Plaid

skins.name: Zinc
skins.description: The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag. A grayscale pattern has been applied.
skins.flavorText: A ripple in time

skins.name: Lab Rats
